items.title: The Law Of The Sublime
items.author: Robert Greene
items.synopsis_short: From the author of the multimillion-copy…
items.synopsis_full: From the author of the multimillion-copy bestsellers The 48 Laws of Power and The Laws of Human Nature comes a life-changing guide to transcending our own limits to master the power of the Sublime. We struggle today to find more meaning in our lives, and to experience the world in ways that go beyond the virtual. The Sublime connects us to the immense forces in the universe, to the inner worlds of other people, and even to other species, lifting us out of ourselves and giving us the dimensions and depths we yearn for in our lives. Robert Greene is a trusted guide for millions of readers, distilling ancient wisdom and philosophy into essential texts for seekers of power, social strategies, and mastery. Now he offers a roadmap to the Sublime, showing us how to liberate ourselves from the constraints of contemporary life. Greene draws from science, mythology, history, the arts, nature, and more to teach us how to: Open our eyes to the strangeness of being alive on this planet Free our minds from conventional ways of thinking and perceiving Harness the intuitions and practices of ancient civilizations to transcend the banalities of modern life Reconnect with our childhood selves to perceive the world anew Draw on the power found at the fringes of human consciousness Access our deepest core self to unleash our natural creative powers The Law of the Sublime opens us to a fuller, more intense relationship to life. Alongside awe-inspiring stories of sublime experiences, including near-death encounters, astonishing discoveries, and radical transformations of consciousness, Greene offers us exercises and meditations to connect with the Sublime that is all around us. This is another masterwork from Robert Greene and is an essential text for anyone in search of life’s deeper meaning.

items.title: Season To Taste
items.author: Corre Larkin
items.synopsis_short: Recipes you won't find in a…
items.synopsis_full: Recipes you won't find in a restaurant, but will want to learn by heart: the simple, comforting, Old World home cooking that has made @cocolarkincooks one of the most rapidly growing recipe creators online The most memorable meals of our lives seldom involve fancy restaurants. More often they involve simple food cooked with affection, and time spent lingering over a table at home with the people we love. Corre Larkin has built a rapidly growing online following by inviting her followers to share those kinds of meals--the ones you won't find in a restaurant, but will find in someone's home. Larkin's recipes are drawn from the family tables of Italy, France, and the UK, where regional classics are cooked from memory from what's on hand and shared with joy. All are shaped by an economy of effort, ingredients, and time. Some are on the table in thirty minutes, while others are suited for a leisurely Sunday, where slow cooking turns a handful of humble ingredients into a feast. Larkin knows that good food makes life better. From Lancashire Hot Pot to Braised Leeks and Potato Dauphinoise, each recipe captures the kind of cooking that feels instinctive and confident--and embodies the comfort of home. If you like to eat well, you're in great hands.
